clips.title: The story
paras: At the Bulwark, Deathguard Linnea sends you to guard Tirisfal's eastern flank. Scourge horrors and lingering spirits haunt Balnir Farmstead, where they threaten the road and the supply lines that keep the front supplied.

The Bulwark holds back the pestilence and armies of the Western Plaguelands from Tirisfal Glades. Deathguard Linnea oversees security behind the frontier. The defenders cannot spare troops to guard against attacks from the rear. Any undead that slip past the choke point must be destroyed before they can cut the supply lines feeding the front.

Balnir Farmstead was once a working farm in eastern Tirisfal, but it fell to ruin during the Third War. Blight covers its fields, and its crumbling stables shelter Bleeding Horrors and restless Wandering Spirits. Clearing the farmstead denies the Lich King a place to gather forces inside Tirisfal and keeps the road open for Horde reinforcements.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.
Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.
Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have a report of your patrol?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
